scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run check-public-archives && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.eas-build-post-install: command -v pod && echo 'pod found' || (for d in /opt/homebrew/bin /opt/homebrew/opt/cocoapods/bin /usr/local/bin /usr/bin; do [ -f "$d/pod" ] && ln -sf "$d/pod" /usr/local/bin/pod && echo "Linked pod from $d" && break; done) || sudo gem install cocoapods
